_comment: Control for text_rebase_t5base_t5large_steer_linearprobe.json: few-shot linear probing of the TARGET model alone (google/t5-v1_1-large), with no steering applied. This is the number the steer_text run has to beat.
_why_alpha_0: There is no standalone text linear-probe entrypoint (vision has eval/vision_linear_probe.py). alpha=0 is the equivalent: steer_text_correction_context adds alpha*correction to the pooled feature (steer_text.py:780), so at 0 the probe trains, and is scored, on the plain target base. Both the 'target_zeroshot' and 'rebased' columns then report the same probe accuracy and 'norm' is 1.0.
_cheap_stage2: stage_2_strategy/feature_regime are downgraded from block_ridge/linear on purpose: the correction is multiplied by zero, so the per-block forward-mode jvp through t5-base would be pure waste. prepare() still extracts pooled features for the support set -- unavoidable without a dedicated entrypoint, and the feature cache makes a rerun cheap.
_comparability: Keep source/target models, tasks, seed, method_params.few_shot, linear_probe_epochs and linear_probe_lr identical to the steer_text run being compared against -- same backbone, same probe budget, same support examples.
